WITH defaults AS (
            SELECT
                jd.default_priority,
                jd.max_attempts,
                jd.default_timeout_seconds
            FROM job_definitions jd
            WHERE jd.job_type = $1
              AND jd.is_enabled = true
         )
         INSERT INTO job_queue (
            job_type,
            organization_id,
            payload,
            priority,
            max_attempts,
            timeout_seconds,
            next_run_at,
            idempotency_key,
            stage
         )
         SELECT
            $1,
            $2,
            $3::jsonb,
            COALESCE($4, d.default_priority),
            COALESCE($5, d.max_attempts),
            COALESCE($6, d.default_timeout_seconds),
            COALESCE($7, now()),
            $8,
            $9
         FROM defaults d
         RETURNING id, run_number
